pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ vācenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ vācessanti, seyyathāpi gihīkāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti::
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma: chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ vācessantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ vācentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ vācessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu::
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:2.8: padena vāceti pade pade āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc50:2.17: cittāgāravaggo pañcamo. tassuddānaṃ: rājā sandi suttañca gihīvūpasamena ca, dade cīvarāvasathaṃ pariyāpuṇavācaneti.
